figures.caption: Controller vs baseline vs prompt-hint on belief_holdout OOD (n=367+1101+1101=2569). Controller delivers strictly positive net improvement on both models; the prompt-hint baseline is net-negative on both (actively harmful on pythia-2.8b: −87). World-knowledge accuracy exactly preserved across arms.
M4.3 OOD summary: controller wins over prompt-hint on both Pythia scales; effect size differs (+151 on 1b vs +27 on 2.8b — see caveat C4.2 about non-uniform gain across scale).
